verdict.rationale: The agency's own Business Division page says founders can 'File Your Wyoming LLC, Profit, Nonprofit, or Limited Partnership Online Now!', and the homepage offers an Annual Report Wizard to file electronically. A probe confirmed the WyoBiz filing portal is publicly reachable. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that fees are paid online within the formation flow, step-by-step docs of the online filing process, and hands-on evidence of completing a filing end-to-end (the probe shows only that the portal is reachable).
